data 节点专注存储与本地搜索执行，coordinating 节点专注解析、分发与合并——各自优化、互为补充
data 节点只负责处理写入请求，不参与搜索执行
options_en: Data nodes and coordinating nodes actually do exactly the same work
The reverse: coordinating nodes store data and data nodes handle routing
Data nodes focus on storage and local search execution while coordinating nodes focus on parsing, routing, and merging, each optimized independently
Data nodes only handle write requests and take no part in search execution
tradeoff: 存储与本地执行（data 节点）vs 请求编排与合并（coordinating 节点）
why: 存储与查询编排分离让两类节点可按各自瓶颈独立扩展和调优，是 Elasticsearch 架构的一条核心设计经验。
why_en: Data nodes focus on storage and local search execution while coordinating nodes parse, route, and merge, letting each be optimized independently.
